description: A two-face rescue tower with nonperiodic moving fire fronts, travelling finite water pulses, and floor thermal locks.
name: Firewatch Fold V3 · Difficulty 3 · Full Interaction
natural_language: Contain the moving fire fronts, climb unlocked ladders, and reach the resident. Both fire gutters and their 600-ms trails stay visible. Ladder plans and the resident location are concealed until inspected; use the eye to survey alternating faces. Surveyed plans stay visible. Start the rescue when ready. Certify the rescue within 180 seconds after Start. Water travels along the last horizontal direction for the dashed reach. Aim ahead using core trails and white current-velocity arrows; dotted bars show cruise velocity. Match the first core hit using AMBER, TEAL or ROSE canisters. Each front needs one matching canister; a miss ends the attempt. Inspection neither moves the firefighter nor pauses a started rescue. Walk past a face edge to cross the fold. Use arrow keys or WASD to move, 1/2/3 to select canisters, and Shift to fire. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in this task webpage. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network, source, DOM or page-state inspection, terminal, shell, Python, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload/navigation, browser extensions, external applications, hidden-state access, or unrelated tabs. Only task tabs opened by visible task controls may be used.
